headline: DON TOLIVER EARNS FIRST VMA NOMINATION
caption:
Don Toliver has earned his first MTV Video Music Awards nomination in the Best Hip-Hop category. The Houston artist joins a field that includes Drake, Cardi B with Kehlani, and Tyler, the Creator ahead of the September 27 ceremony in Los Angeles.

Source: MTV VMAs and Houston Chronicle
https://www.houstonchronicle.com/entertainment/music/article/mtv-vmas-madonna-hip-hop-nominees-drake-houston-22392903.php
